revision_basis.reason: Compatibility provenance retained for the original fail-closed phase-1 implementation.

exact_dem_revision_basis.diagnosis: The frozen catchment geometries were generated from exact target-specific DEM crops derived from frozen static geometry contracts. Phase-1 revisions 0.2/0.3 reconstructed a 30 m grid from rounded diagnostic bbox metadata. Even when cell alignment is recovered, bilinear reprojection values and therefore local D8 topology need not be identical to the exact geometry-generation DEM. A frozen polygon/outlet topology must therefore be evaluated on the exact DEM reconstruction that generated the frozen geometry, not on an approximately reconstructed raster.
exact_dem_revision_basis.correction_scope: DEM reconstruction provenance only. Recompute each target's exact unrounded geometry-generation bbox from its already-frozen pre-unblind geometry inputs and chosen frozen margin; regenerate the DEM using the unchanged Copernicus source tiles and processing; require exact GeoTIFF SHA256 equality to geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 before computing any target metric.

frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.source_tile_integrity: all source tiles must match preregistered SHA256 values

target_rules.cashahuacra: recompute exact bbox from frozen ANA upstream/downstream WGS84 anchors plus the frozen 0.08 degree margin used by its geometry delineator
target_rules.quirio: recompute exact base WGS84 extent from frozen MML R4/R8/R9 UTM18S anchors and add geometry_freeze.chosen_margin_degrees
target_rules.pedregal_san_antonio: recompute exact base WGS84 extent from geometry contract base_extent_points_utm18s and add geometry_freeze.chosen_margin_degrees
target_rules.la_libertad: recompute exact base WGS84 extent from geometry contract base_extent_points_utm18s and add geometry_freeze.chosen_margin_degrees
target_rules.carossio: recompute exact base WGS84 extent from geometry contract base_extent_points_utm18s and add geometry_freeze.chosen_margin_degrees
target_rules.rayos_de_sol: recompute exact base WGS84 extent from Corrales geometry contract base_extent_points_utm18s and add geometry_freeze.chosen_margin_degrees

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.hard_integrity_gate: regenerated DEM GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 for every target before morphometry is accepted
exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.fallback: none; any hash mismatch fails closed

pourpoint_semantics.rule: an excluded polygonized pour point may terminate routing only when the exact geometry-generation D8 topology contains at least one in-mask predecessor routing directly to that frozen outlet; exact frozen polygon mask remains unchanged

cell_inclusion.polygon_metrics: project exact frozen polygon to EPSG:32718
cell_inclusion.raster_metrics: cell center inside polygon; rasterio all_touched=false
cell_inclusion.nodata: exclude non-finite or DEM nodata cells

hydrology.routing_integrity: at least 99.5 percent of exact frozen-polygon center cells must route to the frozen outlet
hydrology.drainage_density_threshold: contributing area >= 0.01 * exact frozen polygon planar area

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
use metric values observed in failed phase-1 runs to tune a method
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
alter a geometry contract, chosen margin, source tile, DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, D8 method, channel threshold or cell-inclusion rule to improve a result
accept a regenerated DEM whose GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
